safety_verdicts.content: Patient is systemically well, denying any fevers, vomiting, shortness of breath, cough, or bowel symptoms.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes denial of fever/cough/SOB and normal bowel function (History_of_Present_Illness-005; History_of_Present_Illness-006) but does not mention vomiting, which is explicitly included in the Gold fact.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document denial of vomiting slightly weakens the assessment of systemic illness/red flags in a patient with a new widespread itchy rash, and could reduce clarity if symptoms evolve. However, multiple other systemic negatives (fever, SOB, cough, bowel symptoms) were captured, lowering the likelihood of missed acute deterioration.
